title: work.item@1
description: A work source's reading (#364): one item where work comes from, with a link back, its acceptance criteria and each author's role as the provider's membership record gives it, never as the item's text says.

source_id.description: The item's ID at its source, such as owner/repo#12.

link.description: Where the item lives at its source.

body.description: A handle to the item's body, never its text inline.

items.description: One acceptance criterion, as the source writes it.

criteria.description: The item's acceptance criteria, in order.

handle.description: The author's account at the source.

role.description: The author's role, from the provider's membership record.

x-closure.closed: an author owns the repo, collaborates on it, or is outside it
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this kind

authors.description: Everyone who wrote the item's text, each with their role.

updated.description: When the source last changed the item, as the source gives it.
